title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under social influence, information exposure, and policy interventions.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals adjust mask adoption based on the proportion of masked peers in their social network and households.

interactions.name: information_exposure
interactions.description: People consume messages from media channels (pro/neutral/anti) which shift their attitudes and adoption likelihood.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask mandates with warnings/fines; individuals may comply or resist based on sensitivity and trust.

interactions.name: location_encounters
interactions.description: Contacts occur at locations (home, work/school, public) influencing observed norms and immediate compliance.

interactions.name: policy_communication
interactions.description: Authority communicates guidance and mandate status, affecting perceived norms and policy influence.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each timestep.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption rate first reaches 50%.

metrics.name: time_to_80_percent
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption rate first reaches 80%.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate during the simulation.

metrics.name: post_policy_sustainability
metrics.description: Average adoption rate in a window after the mandate ends (e.g., days mandate_end_day+1 to mandate_end_day+30).

metrics.name: compliance_under_mandate
metrics.description: Adoption rate in locations where a mandate is active versus where it is not.

metrics.name: group_adoption_disparity
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates across demographic or socioeconomic groups.

metrics.name: churn_rate
metrics.description: Share of adopters who stop wearing masks per day.

metrics.name: exposure_to_misinformation
metrics.description: Average probability that individuals encounter anti-mask messages per day.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_per_1000
metrics.description: Number of warnings/fines issued per 1000 people per day.
